job.name: hist_host_c
job.meaning: мужчина ~50, седеющие волосы, очки в тонкой оправе, твидовый пиджак, фон — кабинет с картой и глобусом
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a Russian man about 50, greying swept-back hair, thin metal-rimmed glasses, a brown tweed jacket over a dark knit sweater. Background: a historian's study with an old map of Russia on the wall, a globe and stacks of books, softly out of focus, warm evening lamp light. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, waist-up, both shoulders fully inside the frame, centred, top of head about 14% below the upper edge, face large and sharp, looking straight into the lens. Expression: calm, intrigued storyteller about to share a secret, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame shot on a modern camera, true-to-life colours, natural unretouched skin with pores, NOT a studio glamour portrait, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary person (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
